title: RichTextLabel/Container freeze+crash introduced in 4.7
body: ### Tested versions This is a bug introduced in commit [aa094e93e36d9c310d0f40c466f0e063b7a7c9d4]. This bug is not present in the previous commit, [4c6246052b11f8ad1e5aad2b73d70df53ab9da87]. This issue is currently reproducible in 4.7, 4.7.1, and the master branch (as of August 5th, 2026). ### System information Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9608) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900HX (32 threads) - 31.69 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description Having certain combinations of UI elements under containers causes the engine to freeze, as it continuously notifies itself of UI updates until running out of memory. In my MRP this is a result of having a TextureRect set to 'Fit Width,' a RichTextLabel with 'Fit Content' on, and a Control with a custom minimum width. Different strings in the RichTextLabel cause the engine to hang, and capitalization strangely does not seem to matter. `bool exceeds = scroll_active && p_total_height > p_ctrl_height && p_width > vscroll->get_bound_minimum_size().width; ` The commit only adds a single new condition to the end of a bool in `rich_text_label.cpp`, and calling that on its own does not crash the engine. I'm not sure if the change doesn't work structurally or if it exposes an existing issue with sizing. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create a scene inheriting from Container 1.1. Set the x of its minimum size to 300 2. Under that Container, add a VBoxContainer 3. Under the VBoxContainer, add an HBoxContainer 4. Under the HBoxContainer, add a TextureRect 4.1. It should use any texture, and its Expand Mode should be set to 'Fit Width' 5. Under the HBoxContainer, add a RichTextLabel 5.1. 'Fit Content' should be set to true 5.2. Set the text to `qwertyuiop`. Certain other strings work too. Capitalization does not seem to matter 5.3. In Container Sizing, under Horizontal, it should have Expand set to true 6. Under the HBoxContainer, add a Control 6.1. Set the x of its minimum size to 32 7. Run the scene 8. Enjoy Your scene should be structured like the screenshot below ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) The bug is visible in a brand new project but here is a download for your convenience, since there are a decent amount of steps to recreate the issue [broken_rich_text_mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30798333/broken_rich_text_mrp.zip)
